scope: Explicit command API boundary; device capture/full replay not yet implemented

rows.name: Queued directions do not mutate battle before a simulation boundary
Rendering does not consume queued commands
A diagonal is one direction sample at the boundary
Release returns to neutral through real input code
Commands in freeze use the normal input buffer
Frozen steps remain distinct on the command timeline
Buffered command starts after freeze through normal rules
Internal buffer consumption does not duplicate external commands
Reset drops the old command session
Forced single-step applies action buttons as a running simulation
Build fingerprint is embedded and immutable
